g.text: 27'-1 3/8" BLDG. HT., D.F.E. TO MEAN ROOF (35'-0" MAX.)
HANDRAILS BOTH SIDES, TO POOL DECK EL. 8.40'
LOT 14, BLOCK C, HERON SOUND ESTATES
NO SEAL. NO ENGINEER OF RECORD.
ELEVATIONS IN FEET ARE IN NAVD 88. HEIGHTS ARE TO THE TOP OF CONCRETE OR THE TOP OF FRAMING.
FLOOD ZONE AE, PANEL 12000C0000J (DEMO). B.F.E. 9.00', D.F.E. 10.00', F.F.E. 11.00' NAVD. THE LOWEST
FLOOR IS 2'-0" ABOVE THE B.F.E. (FBC-R R322.2.1).
THE GARAGE IS BELOW THE D.F.E.: PARKING, ACCESS AND STORAGE ONLY. FLOOD DAMAGE-RESISTANT
MATERIALS BELOW THE D.F.E. FLOOD VENTS PER S-101.
STUCCO: 3 COATS, 7/8" ON LATH OVER FRAMING, 5/8" ON MASONRY, WITH CONTROL JOINTS AT 144 SQ. FT.
MAX. AND AT EVERY CHANGE OF SUBSTRATE (ASTM C926, C1063).
ALL WINDOWS AND DOORS IMPACT RATED, WITH FLORIDA PRODUCT APPROVAL, FOR THE DESIGN
PRESSURES ON A-601. WINDOW HEADS: FIRST FLOOR 8'-0", SECOND FLOOR 7'-2" A.F.F.; GARAGE WINDOW
ROOFING: STANDING SEAM METAL WITH FLORIDA PRODUCT APPROVAL, ON SELF-ADHERED
BUILDING HEIGHT IS MEASURED FROM THE D.F.E. (10.00' NAVD) TO THE MEAN ROOF HEIGHT: 27'-1 3/8", 35'-0"
FINISH GRADE 8.00' NAVD AT THE FOUNDATION (EXISTING 7.50'), SLOPING AWAY 6" IN THE FIRST 10'-0" TO
ENTRY STAIR: 5 RISERS OF 6.4" AND 4 TREADS OF 11" FROM THE PORCH (10.67') TO THE WALK. LANAI STEPS:
4 RISERS OF 6.8" AND 3 TREADS OF 11" TO THE POOL DECK (8.40'). HANDRAILS BOTH SIDES OF EACH, 34" TO
GUARDS: 36" HIGH AT THE ENTRY PORCH'S OPEN EDGE AND THE LANAI'S WEST, NORTH AND EAST SIDES,
WHERE THE SLAB IS MORE THAN 30" ABOVE GRADE. NO OPENING PASSES A 4" SPHERE (FBC-R R312.1).
